scope: Primary source facts supporting the 29-profile catalogue (ChipProfiles.all): nine generation/sample presets added 2026-09-30, and the gmrtd README and parsed-SOD samples behind 21 profiles added or corrected on 2026-10-12. Sources first retrieved on 2026-09-30 keep that date. On 2026-10-16 the eleven profiles whose access control and PACE suite were both unsourced were removed, with their sources.
artifact_policy: Full downloaded third-party works are cached outside the repository; no redistribution licence established. Cached paths are local conveniences and may expire. Source URLs and locators remain authoritative; notes are authored summaries, not original evidence.

sources.title: gmrtd README, Sample Documents table
locators: Sample Documents table, one row per real document (Country, Type,Year, PACE, Chip Authentication, Active Authentication / "Cloneable", extended length, LDS version columns)
Rows used: NL PP 2025, UK P 2021, US P 2021, CA PP 2023, AU P 2016 and the 16 rows of the remaining-samples round (AT, CN, FI x2, FR x2, HK, ID, MY, NZ, PH, PT, RU, SG x2, TW)
sources.supports: Observed access control, PACE and Chip Authentication suites and curves, and listed Active Authentication or "Cloneable" for single real documents. One mechanism per cell: silence is not evidence of absence. It does not define the Type column's codes, and names the Russian curve only as "secp192".
sources.generation_boundary: One real document per row; the row's year only. No claim about other documents of the same country or year.

sources.title: gmrtd parsed real EF.SOD vectors, TestNewSod
locators: TestNewSod, test cases labelled by a country comment (// AT, // CN, // FI, // FR, // MY, // NZ, // PH, // RU, // SG, // UK, // US, // AU and others): each SOD is parsed to its Document Signer certificate, LDS/Unicode version, and data group hashes (a profile's evidence names the vector it uses)
sources.supports: Document Signer key type, signature and digest algorithms, and which data groups one sampled SOD hashes. A data group missing from one SOD does not show that the chip lacks the feature (for example DG15 and Active Authentication). The vectors do not say which README row (for example the two Singapore ones) a SOD belongs to.
sources.generation_boundary: One sampled SOD per vector; not a statement about every document of the country or year.

sources.title: gmrtd parsed real EF.SOD vectors, TestPassiveAuth
locators: TestPassiveAuth, test cases labelled by a country comment (including "ID", the Indonesian 2010 CSCA Series case): SOD, optional EF.CardSecurity and the passive-authentication result, from which the Document Signer's validity, key and signature algorithm are read
sources.supports: Same as TestNewSod, with Document Signer validity dates; the Indonesian SOD and its hashed data groups.
sources.generation_boundary: One sampled SOD per vector; not a statement about every document of the country or year.
